flow-definition.description: Downloads one Terraform env template. Resolution order is stack-specific S3, shared S3, then the infrastructure repository. Select the service and optionally a target stack.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Infrastructure repository revision used for the final fallback. Leave empty to resolve it from build-spec.json.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: SERVICE
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Service whose Terraform env template should be downloaded.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: TARGET_STACK
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Optional target stack identifier (for example, a or b). Leave empty to skip the stack-specific S3 path.

definition.script:
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper;
def infrastructure_git_hash
pipeline { agent any
options { skipDefaultCheckout(true) }
stages { stage('Clean Workspace') { steps { deleteDir() } }
stage('Download Template') { steps { script { def s3Status = sh(script: '''#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/" shopt -s nullglob for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [[ -f "$script_file" && -x "$script_file" ]]; then source "$script_file" fi done shopt -u nullglob
for fn in assume_role reset_role; do if ! command -v "$fn" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Error: required function '$fn' was not loaded from $source_scripts_folder." >&2 exit 1 fi done
: "${SERVICE:?SERVICE is required}" : "${stack_s3_bucket:?stack_s3_bucket is required}"
case "$SERVICE" in Gateway) template_file="gateway.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/gateway/templates" ;; Operations) template_file="operations.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/operations/templates" ;; Query) template_file="query.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/query/templates" ;; "HPDS Auth") template_file="hpds-auth.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/hpds/templates" ;; "HPDS Open") template_file="hpds-open.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/hpds/templates" ;; Visualization) template_file="visualization.env.tftpl" template_prefix="configs/pic-sure-visualization/templates" ;; *) echo "Error: unsupported SERVICE selection." >&2 exit 1 ;; esac
TARGET_STACK="${TARGET_STACK:-}" role_assumed=false cleanup() { if [[ "$role_assumed" == true ]]; then reset_role fi } trap cleanup EXIT
assume_role role_assumed=true
download_s3_template() { local object_key=$1 local destination=$2 local aws_error local candidate
candidate=$(mktemp "$(dirname "$destination")/.template-download.XXXXXX")
if aws_error=$(aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "s3://$stack_s3_bucket/$object_key" "$candidate" 2>&1 >/dev/null); then if [[ ! -s "$candidate" ]]; then rm -f "$candidate" echo "Error: s3://$stack_s3_bucket/$object_key is empty; refusing to use it." >&2 return 2 fi mv "$candidate" "$destination" return 0 fi
rm -f "$candidate"
case "$aws_error" in *"An error occurred (404)"*|*"An error occurred (NoSuchKey)"*|*"An error occurred (NotFound)"*) return 1 ;; esac
echo "Error: could not read s3://$stack_s3_bucket/$object_key; refusing to fall back after a non-missing-object AWS error." >&2 return 2 }
if [[ -n "$TARGET_STACK" ]]; then if download_s3_template "$template_prefix/$TARGET_STACK/$template_file" "$template_file"; then echo "Using stack-specific S3 template for $template_file" exit 0 else download_status=$? if [[ $download_status -ne 1 ]]; then exit "$download_status" fi fi fi
if download_s3_template "$template_prefix/$template_file" "$template_file"; then echo "Using shared S3 template for $template_file" exit 0 else download_status=$? if [[ $download_status -ne 1 ]]; then exit "$download_status" fi fi
echo "No S3 template found, using repo version of $template_file" printf '%s\n' "$template_file" > .template-file exit 3 ''', returnStatus: true)
if (s3Status == 3) { if (params.INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH?.trim()) { infrastructure_git_hash = params.INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH.trim() echo "Using provided INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH: ${infrastructure_git_hash}" } else { def result = build job: 'Retrieve Build Spec' copyArtifacts filter: 'build-spec.json', projectName: 'Retrieve Build Spec', selector: specific("" + result.number) def buildSpec = new JsonSlurper().parse(new File("${env.WORKSPACE}/build-spec.json")) infrastructure_git_hash = buildSpec.infrastructure_git_hash echo "Resolved INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH from release control: ${infrastructure_git_hash}" }
checkout([ $class: 'GitSCM', userRemoteConfigs: [[ url: "${infrastructure_git_repo}", credentialsId: "${git_credentials_id}" ]], branches: [[name: infrastructure_git_hash]] ])
sh '''#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
template_file=$(<.template-file) case "$template_file" in gateway.env.tftpl|operations.env.tftpl|query.env.tftpl|hpds-auth.env.tftpl|hpds-open.env.tftpl|visualization.env.tftpl) ;; *) echo "Error: invalid repository fallback template filename." >&2 exit 1 ;; esac
repo_template="app-infrastructure/template-renderer/templates/$template_file" if [[ ! -s "$repo_template" ]]; then echo "Error: repository fallback $template_file is missing or empty." >&2 exit 1 fi cp "$repo_template" "$template_file" ''' } else if (s3Status != 0) { error("Template download failed before repository fallback (exit ${s3Status}).") } } } } }
post { success { archiveArtifacts artifacts: '*.env.tftpl', allowEmptyArchive: false } } }
